children: First appointed Rex Cheng as president and Rongmei Yu as chief financial officer and corporate secretary, and both were added to the board effective September 24, 2026.
Chief Financial Officer; Corporate Secretary; Director
President of METech Recycling since Dec 2015; joined company Jan 2006; prior roles: Operations Manager, GM (Gilroy), VP Ops, COO; B.Bus (Univ. of Tasmania, 2002).

Served as CFO of Metech Recycling since Sept 2025; prior Group CFO of Re-Teck/LTG (Aug 2022–June 2025); SVP Finance (2016–2022); prior CFO of a US media company; Senior Analyst at Andersen Consulting; B.Com (Univ. of Sydney, 1996), MBA (Deakin, 2006), B.Sc in Mechanical Eng (Shanghai Univ., 1984); member of CPA Australia.
